scores.label: Scoped WSG audit score
scores.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

scores.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.

guidelines.title: Identify, assess, disclose, review, and mitigate sustainability impacts
guidelines.expectation: A retrieved public sustainability statement identifies the audited service and describes its impacts and mitigation. Judge disclosure only, not execution; an unresolved relationship is cantTell.

judgments.rationale: The retrieved Sustainability considerations page recommends standards, guidelines and quantification methods for Wagtail-powered projects and mentions CMS development internships. It does not explicitly establish documentation-host impacts and mitigation. The bounded disclosure collector returned no service-linked records, which does not prove no policy exists elsewhere. The relationship to docs.wagtail.org remains unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Provide a public statement explicitly identifying this documentation service, its impact boundary and mitigation, or a verifiable relationship to an existing statement.

guidelines.title: Understand user requirements or constraints
guidelines.expectation: For the declared service or feature decision, evidence identifies relevant users and affected communities, their material requirements or constraints, and how research findings changed or confirmed that decision. Persona labels, analytics counts or an auditor completing a task alone do not demonstrate user involvement.

judgments.assessmentScope: The current public decision to organize Wagtail developer documentation into tutorial, how-to, reference and explanation modes: inspect audience rationale and public evidence that user research informed or validated that decision. No internal research or representative-user testing records supplied.
judgments.rationale: The four-mode documentation policy identifies newcomer tutorials, goal-oriented how-to guides, reference users and conceptual explanation needs, and explains why mixed modes impede understanding. It attributes the structure to Diátaxis. It supplies no actual participant scope, research findings or evidence that user involvement changed or validated this specific decision. The policy rationale is useful but does not demonstrate performed audience research.
judgments.nextEvidence: Provide one public decision or research record identifying represented audiences/constraints, relevant findings and how they informed or confirmed the four-mode structure.

guidelines.title: Integrate sustainability into every stage of the ideation process
Design efficient and streamlined user journeys
guidelines.expectation: Execute declared task actions and inspect completion evidence; an expected selector is one observable, not proof of user success or optimal journey length.

judgments.rationale: Setup recorded a complete anonymous search-to-responsive-images route through the embedded search panel. The measured journey filled images and pressed Enter but timed out waiting for the result link, ending at search.html?q=images&check_keywords=yes&area=default with a Cloudflare challenge. A separately loaded search page succeeded in staging. These differing states leave reproducible task completion unresolved; neither the selector timeout nor setup success establishes a globally broken or consistently successful search.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat the route in a linked session with explicit add-on readiness and state capture, distinguishing embedded search from fallback navigation and security challenges before prescribing a site fix.

guidelines.title: Design to assist and not to distract
guidelines.expectation: Assess visible distractions against the declared visitor task; distinguish useful prompts from interruptions.

judgments.rationale: In the successfully rendered homepage, tutorial and sustainability reading states, no overlays, autoplay media or active animations interrupt the developer reading task. Search/navigation and theme controls are relevant aids; the successful contextual search route also observed no blocking banner. This is limited to those captured states; blocked page probes do not establish their normal appearance. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review task interruptions and useful prompts across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Avoid being manipulative or deceptive
guidelines.expectation: Inspect choice wording, defaults, prominence and the observed accept/reject paths for undue steering. DOM text alone does not establish visual parity.

judgments.rationale: No consent, purchase, subscription or comparable accept/reject decision appears in the captured reading/search route. Navigation and the dark-mode control do not establish a consequential consent decision requiring visual accept/reject parity. Failed advertising requests cannot establish the appearance or wording of an ad.
judgments.nextEvidence: Review wording, defaults and visual prominence if a consequential choice is introduced.

guidelines.title: Make deliverables understandable and reusable
guidelines.expectation: Assess the sampled task's wording, headings and terminology for its stated audience; retain uncertainty about unrepresented users.

judgments.rationale: For English developers, the homepage names first steps and usage tasks, the tutorial uses ordered installation headings and concrete code outcomes, and the responsive-image excerpt explains srcset and sizes with input/output examples. Documentation modes distinguish learning, goals, reference and explanation. These sampled wording judgments do not establish comprehension for unrepresented users. The performance page has no clean prose probe in this packet, and several other comparable probes captured challenges. Wording across the complete declared sample therefore remains unresolved.
judgments.nextEvidence: Read the remaining clean sampled articles in a linked session, then validate newcomer comprehension with audience research if extending beyond developer judgment.

guidelines.title: Use a design system for interface consistency
guidelines.expectation: Compare repeated navigation and control names across sampled pages; consistent samples do not prove a documented design system.

judgments.rationale: Rendered documentation pages repeat Wagtail Documentation, Getting started, Tutorial, Usage guide, Advanced and Reference navigation, with consistent breadcrumb, theme and source controls. Successful staged pages corroborate repeated navigation names on image, reference and performance pages. This supports sampled naming consistency, not complete design-system governance. A clean alternate documentation-guidelines state and staged search/release captures extend the naming comparison to the remaining sampled sections.
judgments.nextEvidence: Check any future independently designed interactive components against these established names.

guidelines.title: Optimize media to reduce resource use
guidelines.expectation: The sampled task images preserve useful content and provide proportionate intrinsic dimensions and delivery choices for their rendered size and pixel density. A large image is an investigation candidate until legibility and task value are checked; absent srcset alone is not a failure.

judgments.rationale: The tutorial uses explanatory screenshots with descriptive alt text, generally 1280-pixel intrinsic widths displayed near 680 pixels on desktop and smaller on narrow screens, without srcset. Although URLs end .png, response MIME types show image/webp; tutorial_10 is about 205 kB and tutorial_6 about 110 kB transferred. Several screenshots sit far below the first viewport with loading=auto. Their instructional value is established, but alternative rendition legibility at intended pixel densities and measured deferred loading were not checked. These are optimization candidates, not proof that smaller or lossy images are safe.
judgments.nextEvidence: Compare the largest screenshots at target narrow/desktop densities and test deferred loading for below-fold examples; preserve readable UI details and measure complete-page transfer.

guidelines.title: Ensure animation is proportionate and easy to control
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed animation purpose, playback controls and reduced-motion behavior. A quiet snapshot does not prove no motion occurs elsewhere.

judgments.rationale: No active animation or media playback is recorded in the normal desktop, narrow and reduced-motion reading observations. No playback control is required for absent observed motion; challenge screens are not treated as documentation animation evidence. This does not cover later interactions or animation not captured by the probe. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review any actual motion, its purpose and controls across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Use optimized web typography
guidelines.expectation: Observed web fonts and variants serve the sampled content, with a declared fallback/loading strategy where needed. Do not fail a site merely for using a web font; recommend removal or subsetting only after language and readability requirements are established.

judgments.rationale: Body text uses a system font stack with language coverage fallbacks. Two Font Awesome WOFF2 variants load at roughly 79 kB and 78 kB transferred; their FontFace display value is block. No blocked-font experiment establishes whether icon controls remain discernible, and required icon/language coverage has not been mapped. Using these fonts alone is not a failure.
judgments.nextEvidence: Block icon-font responses and check search, theme, menu and source controls; map used glyphs before considering subsetting or replacement.

guidelines.title: Avoid unwanted notifications
guidelines.expectation: Assess observed alerts and notification permission requests for user value and choice; absence is limited to observed states.

judgments.rationale: The normal reading states record zero Notification.requestPermission calls and no unsolicited alerts or notification controls. Browser permission was already denied, so this supports absence of observed requests rather than proof that all notification routes are disabled. However, this does not resolve the entire declared page sample: some normal JavaScript-enabled observations are missing or blocked, so quiet successful states cannot stand in for those unobserved states.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the missing normal documentation states, then review alerts and permission requests across the declared sample.

guidelines.title: Reduce the impact of downloadable and physical documents
guidelines.expectation: Review print layout visibility and download labels for the declared task. Fetch and inspect document content before asserting optimization or equivalence.

judgments.rationale: Print emulation preserves documentation text and tutorial illustrations but reports four or five visible navigation regions. No downloadable document links were captured on the clean homepage/tutorial states. A paginated print preview was not captured, so the effect on paper use and content clipping cannot be judged; visibility counts alone do not prove waste or breakage.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect a tutorial print preview for page count, clipping and repeated navigation; optimize print CSS only where those observations show avoidable pages.

guidelines.title: Involve users early in the project
Audit and test for bugs or issues requiring resolution
Validate usability through testing and real-world usage
Provide cross-platform compatibility support
guidelines.expectation: The sampled core reading content and navigation remain available without JavaScript, or an explicit alternative supports the task. This bounded check does not establish no-JavaScript search, every interaction, or all browser compatibility.

judgments.rationale: Fresh no-JavaScript home and tutorial pages retain core reading content, headings and navigation; reference, documentation-guidelines and release pages also have usable no-JavaScript observations. Sustainability and performance no-JavaScript observations are Cloudflare challenges, and the image observation failed, preventing comparison across the declared sample. These are collection/access limits rather than proof that documentation content requires JavaScript; search functionality is outside this bounded check.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture clean no-JavaScript reading states for unresolved pages and compare main content/navigation with their matching normal states.

guidelines.title: Set goals based on performance and energy impact
Minify and remove unused code
guidelines.expectation: Use initial JS/CSS execution observations to nominate investigation targets; require representative journeys or source corroboration before recommending removal.

judgments.rationale: Initial-load-plus-500ms coverage records unexecuted ranges in Read the Docs add-ons and unused CSS rules, nominating investigation targets. Coverage uses source offsets and the main target only, not removable network bytes. Search, version navigation and later interactions were not successfully covered end-to-end, and no source corroboration is supplied.
judgments.nextEvidence: Collect representative search, version/menu and copy-code coverage before removing code; separate globally required initialization from truly unused features.

guidelines.title: Modularize bandwidth-heavy components
guidelines.expectation: Relate initial script resources to visible components and later task needs; recommend splitting only when a component's deferred use and usable activation are corroborated.

judgments.rationale: Initial pages load the Read the Docs add-ons script (about 123 kB transferred in the homepage run), vendor/search tools and an add-ons API request. Search is a real user need demonstrated in context, but the later measured search did not complete. Evidence does not isolate a safely deferrable component or demonstrate usable activation after splitting.
judgments.nextEvidence: Trace add-on functions through search and version navigation, then prototype deferral only for components whose later activation remains usable.

guidelines.title: Avoid redundancy and duplication in code
Treat third parties the same as first parties
Ensure code follows good semantic practices
guidelines.expectation: The sampled document has a meaningful language, primary heading and main region, and task controls have visible labels or an explicit naming relationship. Count/attribute presence alone does not establish semantic correctness or WCAG compliance. The sampled initial keyboard path reaches visible task navigation/controls in a meaningful order with a discernible focus indicator. A bounded Tab trace cannot establish complete keyboard support, reverse navigation, traps or screen-reader accessibility.

judgments.rationale: Clean home, tutorial and sustainability documents use lang=en, one main region and descriptive primary headings; search has aria-label Search documentation, menu buttons have text, and copy controls are named. However, several declared pages expose only challenge documents in the comparable desktop state, so their actual task-control semantics are unresolved. This partial positive evidence does not establish WCAG compliance.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture actual documentation states and resolve any custom-element/shadow control names on remaining sampled pages before a full sampled semantic judgment.

judgments.rationale: The first two Tab steps identify the skip link and Wagtail Documentation link with focus-visible and a solid 3-pixel outline. Later steps repeatedly record an invisible zero-size READTHEDOCS-SEARCH shadow host rather than the inner active control, leaving actual task-control order and focus indicators unknown. The skip link geometry is also above the viewport in the recorded instant. These clues require visual/deep-focus verification and do not establish a trap or absent focus.
judgments.nextEvidence: Capture the deeply active shadow element and screenshots during Tab/Shift+Tab navigation; verify skip-link visibility and the subsequent search/menu focus path.

guidelines.title: Defer the loading of non-critical resources
Structure metadata for machine readability
guidelines.expectation: The sampled content has a descriptive title and usable canonical metadata when applicable; declared structured-data blocks parse as JSON. Judge description and other optional metadata according to page purpose, not a mandatory-field checklist.

judgments.rationale: Clean pages have descriptive page-and-version titles; no structured-data blocks are declared, so no JSON parse failure is demonstrated. Canonical and description are null. Descriptions are optional for these technical reading pages, but stable/version alias relationships have not been resolved enough to judge whether canonical metadata is applicable and usable. Challenge metadata is excluded from documentation judgments.
judgments.nextEvidence: Inspect stable versus numbered-version canonical/indexing intentions and capture clean remaining pages; add canonical metadata only where it correctly represents equivalent content.

guidelines.title: Use media queries that support sustainability goals
guidelines.expectation: The sampled page respects applicable dark/reduced-motion preferences both before navigation and when they change in-page, without losing task content. Distinguish intentional design choices and absence of applicable motion from unsupported behavior.

judgments.rationale: Matching clean homepage and tutorial observations retain white rgb(255,255,255) backgrounds after prefers-color-scheme changes live to dark, despite dark=true. Fresh cold-dark loads of these same documentation pages use rgb(18,12,36) backgrounds and retain the same reading content/headings. Thus initial dark preference support exists but an in-page change does not update the observed theme. No motion is recorded in corresponding reduced-motion states. This comparison excludes challenged pages.
judgments.nextEvidence: Update live system-theme handling while preserving explicit user overrides; verify both preference directions without navigation and retain reading content.

guidelines.title: Ensure layouts work for different devices and requirements
guidelines.expectation: Compare narrow and desktop task content and overflow, then exercise affected controls; width emulation alone is not real-device compatibility.

judgments.rationale: At 360 and 1280 CSS pixels the clean homepage, tutorial and sustainability pages report no document horizontal overflow and retain reading headings. The main menu is hidden in narrow snapshots, but the mobile menu was not exercised; several other desktop/narrow probes captured Cloudflare challenges. Width-only snapshots cannot establish the affected navigation controls work across the declared sample.
judgments.nextEvidence: Exercise the narrow menu, search and wide code/image content on clean pages; include a real mobile task before a broader compatibility claim.

guidelines.title: Use sustainable JavaScript and APIs
guidelines.expectation: Repeated observed API requests are justified by the sampled task and its update needs. Identify redundant-looking requests for investigation without inferring backend cost or safe removal from URL repetition alone.

judgments.rationale: The clean initial network traces show one add-ons configuration XHR and one page-specific analytics XHR per homepage/tutorial load, without a demonstrated recurring polling loop. Similar URLs across distinct page loads are not redundant within one task. Initial-only windows and an incomplete measured search do not establish later API purpose, request duplication or freshness requirements; failed EthicalAds requests do not quantify removable backend cost.
judgments.nextEvidence: Trace API calls through a successful reading/search journey and short idle window, identifying purposes and cache behavior before proposing request removal.

guidelines.title: Use dependencies sparingly and maintain them
Include expected and beneficial files
guidelines.expectation: The sampled service exposes a discoverable, parseable carbon.txt with usable declared relationships. Missing carbon.txt is a scoped absence, not proof of high emissions or failure of the entire guideline. Judge redirects, delegation, supported versions and schema findings explicitly.

judgments.rationale: Both /carbon.txt and /.well-known/carbon.txt return 404, with no Carbon-Location, redirect or delegated relationship discovered. Therefore the sampled standard discovery routes do not expose a parseable carbon.txt. No supported version/schema/organization relationships can be assessed without a retrieved file. This is a scoped metadata absence, not evidence of high emissions or full-guideline failure.
judgments.nextEvidence: If useful for this service, publish a valid carbon.txt with accurate hosting/organization relationships or delegation; validate its declared version and corroborating records.

guidelines.title: Use the most efficient solution for your service
Use the latest stable language version
Reduce the number and complexity of database queries
Use sustainable hosting
guidelines.expectation: Hosting claims identify provider, service and supporting evidence with a relationship to this origin. Self-declaration without independently corroborated operational scope remains cantTell for sustainable hosting; do not set SWDM green-hosting flags from this check.

judgments.rationale: No retrieved disclosure record ties operational sustainability evidence to the audited origin. Read the Docs resource URLs and references to Green Web Foundation internships identify technology/partnership context, not independently corroborated provider/service energy performance. Sustainable hosting cannot be concluded and no green-hosting model flag follows.
judgments.nextEvidence: Obtain origin-specific provider/service relationships and dated, independently corroborated operational energy/emissions evidence.

guidelines.title: Optimize caching and support offline access
guidelines.expectation: Reusable public scripts/styles/media expose an appropriate caching or validation policy in the sample. Distinguish dynamic/private responses and note that headers alone do not prove cache reuse or offline support.

judgments.rationale: Successful public pages expose cache-control max-age=1800, stale-if-error=86400, public plus ETags for reusable first-party styles, scripts and media; the add-ons bundle has max-age=1200 and an ETag. These provide bounded public reuse/validation policies appropriate to release-linked documentation. Error/challenge responses are excluded. Headers do not establish measured warm-cache reuse or offline access.
judgments.nextEvidence: Use a warm-load test if claiming actual saved transfer; consider longer lifetimes only with reliable versioning/invalidation.

guidelines.title: Reduce data transfer with compression
guidelines.expectation: Material sampled text assets are delivered with compression where beneficial. Do not demand compression for already-compressed images, tiny bodies or error responses without context.

judgments.rationale: Material successful HTML and CSS responses use gzip, and core JavaScript responses use Brotli; the larger add-ons JavaScript response uses gzip. This directly supports compressed delivery of sampled material text assets. Already-compressed WOFF2/WebP media and challenge/error responses are not used to demand additional compression.
judgments.nextEvidence: Recheck compression when delivery configuration changes; no specific compression repair is supported by this sample.

guidelines.title: Setup necessary error pages and redirection links
Avoid maintaining unnecessary virtualized environments or containers
Use automation wisely
Define the frequency of data refreshes
Back up critical data at routine intervals
Assess the impact and requirements of data processing
Use Content Delivery Networks (CDNs) when beneficial
Ensure infrastructure fits project requirements
Store data according to the needs of your users
Have an ethical and sustainable product strategy
Assign a sustainability advocate
Inform, raise awareness, and train for sustainability
Communicate the environmental impact of user choices
guidelines.expectation: Identify consequential user choices in the sample and assess whether contextual impact information is useful and supported. Do not prescribe carbon labels on every control.

judgments.rationale: The bounded task is reading documentation and locating an image guide. No comparable resource-intensive user choice such as media quality or bulk export is established on this route. Ordinary navigation and a theme toggle do not justify mandatory carbon labels. Developer guidance about image formats is educational content, not a measured footprint choice for this documentation host.
judgments.nextEvidence: Reassess if a consequential media, download or hosted-environment activation choice is included in a future task.

guidelines.title: Calculate the environmental impact
Define clear organizational sustainability goals and metrics
guidelines.expectation: Published goals for the audited web service define a measurable target or direction, relevant metric and boundary, and communicate dated progress against a comparable baseline. A corporate net-zero ambition or isolated low-carbon badge cannot establish service-specific goals and progress.

judgments.assessmentScope: Published goals and progress specifically for docs.wagtail.org as available in its current sustainability-considerations page and disclosure collection. Distinguish advice for Wagtail-powered websites and CMS-wide work from documentation-host-specific targets, boundaries and comparable results.
judgments.rationale: The current sustainability guidance names accounting standards and possible tools for Wagtail projects and CMS development work. It supplies no docs.wagtail.org-specific target period, metric/boundary or dated comparable baseline and progress record. General recommendations cannot establish this host has measured goals, and their absence from the bounded sample does not establish no internal goals exist.
judgments.nextEvidence: Publish or supply one documentation-host-specific goal with metric, service boundary, target period and dated comparable baseline/progress, explaining any method changes.

guidelines.title: Validate web sustainability efforts through external verification
Support mandatory disclosures and reporting
Create one or more impact business models
Follow a product management and maintenance strategy
Implement continuous improvement procedures
Document updates and evolutions
Evaluate if a digital product or service is necessary
guidelines.expectation: For the declared visitor task and represented access constraints, inspect material accessibility, technical, geographic or fairness barriers and verify the sampled route or alternative supports task completion while preserving necessary security and safety. Do not demand removal of justified authentication or infer all-user accessibility from one successful route.

judgments.assessmentScope: Anonymous English desktop readers with JavaScript enabled, using pointer interaction and text entry: search from the stable homepage for images and reach complete responsive-image documentation without authentication or personal-data submission. Keyboard-only, assistive-technology, constrained-network and non-English completion are outside this task.
judgments.rationale: The contextual walkthrough satisfies the declared anonymous English desktop pointer/text-entry route, reaching responsive-image examples without login or personal-data submission. A subsequent measured run instead follows the fallback search URL and ends at a Cloudflare verification page after the result click times out. This contradictory completion evidence leaves reliable completion within the same broad scope unresolved. It does not prove all visitors face a barrier or that necessary security should be removed.
judgments.nextEvidence: Repeat the scoped route with explicit search readiness and capture any challenge completion or usable alternative; determine whether automation timing, add-on readiness or security controls explain the differing outcomes.

guidelines.title: Provide a supplier standards of practice document
Share economic benefits
Share decision-making power with affected parties
Use Diversity, Equity, Justice, Inclusion (DEJI) practices
Promote responsible data practices
guidelines.expectation: For a declared content collection, evidence identifies a review/expiry schedule and demonstrates an applied archive, update or deletion decision, with a lightweight discoverable historical version where users still need it. A date label, old article or policy alone cannot establish an effective lifecycle or justify deletion.

judgments.assessmentScope: English Wagtail developer documentation through the publicly documented Wagtail 8.0 release: assess release-linked maintenance policy, a documented applied update/removal, and continued discoverability of v7.0 historical image guidance. Judge lifecycle rather than whether old supported documentation should be deleted.
judgments.rationale: Within the stated release-linked boundary, contributor guidance specifies removing short-lived version directives after two releases, and the release process describes three-month feature releases, branch responsibilities and documentation backports. The dated August 25, 2026 Wagtail 8.0 notes record an applied removal of deprecated USE_L10N documentation and other documentation updates. The captured v7.0 image guide retains useful historical responsive-image guidance, and the homepage release-note index makes the historical release discoverable. This supports one bounded public lifecycle example, attributed to publisher records rather than independently verified organization-wide execution.
judgments.nextEvidence: Preserve versioned historical access; extend the sample with a specific review log only if assessing wider editorial lifecycle effectiveness.

guidelines.title: Establish responsible practices around AI and emerging or disruptive technologies
Adopt responsible financial practices
Adopt organizational philanthropy practices
Plan for a digital product or service's care and end-of-life
Repair, reuse, refurbish, recycle or reduce e-waste
Define performance, environmental, and human budgets
Use and contribute to open source
Create a business continuity and disaster recovery plan
